summary: Closed at the day's lows: Nifty down about 1.5% below 22,800 and Sensex off about 1,090 in the closing auction, with all 30 Sensex stocks red.

detail.leaders: None; every Sensex constituent ended lower
detail.laggards: PSU banks (−2.5%+), private banks, realty, metals, auto; late IT selling (Tech Mahindra, Infosys); Nifty MidCap 100 −1.32%, SmallCap 100 −1.45%
detail.tone: Worse than 15:00: the Nifty went from 22,805 to 22,788.25 (−352.25) in the closing auction, below the 22,800 level watched all afternoon. There was no end-of-day short-covering; the session ended at its weakest point.
watch: The US 10-yr and Brent before Tuesday's open
